billing.order_lines: each (order_ref, sku) pair is billed at most once; recurring services get a new order_ref for every billing

document_window: invoices.jsonl and payments.jsonl also contain documents from about 30 days before and 5 days after the period; those must not be posted in this ledger.

fx.invoice_posting: 1200 debit and 4000 credit, both converted at the invoice rate
fx.missing_rate_description: if fx.csv has no rate for the selected date, use the latest earlier date that has one
fx.payment_posting: 1000 and 2300 converted at the payment rate; each 1200 credit converted at the rate of the invoice it settles; the difference goes to 7900
fx.quote: rate = units of target_currency for 1 unit of source_currency
fx.rate_date_rule_description: rate of the document's calendar date in company_timezone

ledger_scope: Postings of documents that belong to the reporting period only; no opening balances.

payments.allocation_source: invoice_refs: list of {invoice_id, amount_minor} in the payment currency (always the invoice currency); null when the payer gave no reference
payments.refunds: negative amount_minor, no invoice_refs; debit 2300, credit 1000; ledger currency only
payments.unallocated_amounts: payments without invoice_refs and any excess of amount_minor over the sum of invoice_refs are credited to 2300

period.attribution: A document belongs to the period that contains its own timestamp (invoices: issued_at, payments: timestamp) converted to company_timezone.

rounding.description: round half away from zero to an integer number of minor units
